details.record_schema: CycleRecord {cycle_id, timestamp, observable, orientation, decision, execution_report, metrics, checkpoint_id}

details.linkage_to_cycles: MANUAL - No direct foreign key linking LTM to CycleRecord
details.consolidation_policy: MANUAL - No automatic STM→LTM consolidation trigger
details.readiness_for_structured_data: PARTIAL - LTM is structured, but STM→LTM linkage needs formalization

details.decision_sourcing: Orienter phase reads from structured data; decision is deterministic
details.traceability: FULL - Decision chain auditable from JSONL

details.rule_application: Runtime evaluation in RBAC policy engine
details.dynamic_adaptation: PARTIAL - Rules can be updated; agent capabilities static
details.readiness_for_structured_data: NEEDS_WORK - RBAC rules should be versioned JSONL; current format ad-hoc
READY - SQLite can export to JSONL; metrics already structured

blocking_issues: No foreign key linking between LTM and cycles

jsonl_ingestion_readiness.question: Can runtime systems NATIVELY integrate with structured JSONL?
gaps_to_100_percent: Implement YAML→JSONL conversion for static configs

integration_blocking_points.blocker: Cannot link STM to cycle records
integration_blocking_points.solution: Implement STM as JSONL append-only log per cycle

integration_blocking_points.issue: Rules in ad-hoc JSON; no versioning
integration_blocking_points.blocker: Cannot track RBAC history; audit trail incomplete

integration_blocking_points.issue: Implicit in GitHub API responses; not persisted
integration_blocking_points.blocker: Workflow state not queryable in structured form
integration_blocking_points.solution: Extract and persist workflow state as JSONL on each update

integration_blocking_points.issue: YAML registry; not queryable as structured data
integration_blocking_points.blocker: Cannot trace capability usage across cycles
integration_blocking_points.solution: Convert AGENT_REGISTRY.yaml to queryable JSONL with history
integration_blocking_points.impact: LOW - Nice to have, not blocking

readiness_summary.timeline_to_100_percent: 2-3 sprints with focused work on 4 gap areas

recommendations.scope: Short-term Memory storage and linkage to cycles
recommendations.design: STM JSONL with per-cycle records: {cycle_id, timestamp, stm_state, ttl}
RBAC history JSONL: {rule_id, version, policy_json, timestamp, applied_by}
recommendations.benefit: Enable audit trail and policy rollback

recommendations.design: Workflow state JSONL: {workflow_id, status, artifact_refs, timestamp}
recommendations.benefit: Enable workflow state queries and recovery

recommendations.design: Tool in scripts/ingestion/ to convert and version static configs
recommendations.benefit: Enable static config history and queries
